segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey Dana, thanks for making time. I saw your note about adding the maintenance team before the March rollout, so I wanted to walk through seat count and timing.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, so we have 42 users today. We need 16 more for the second plant, mostly technicians who will log calibration results and pull certificates.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. That puts you at 58 total seats. On the current pricing sheet, the 51-to-75 seat band is $74 per user per month, billed annually. Since your renewal is June 30, we can co-term the 16 seats from March 1 through June 30 for $4,736 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that number is workable. Can the invoice show the added seats separate from the base subscription? Finance asked for that because it hits a different cost center.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can list it as a separate line item: 16 additional technician seats, March 1 to June 30, cost center 4812 if that is still the right one.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It is. And for go-live, we’re targeting March 4. We’ll need the users active the Friday before, February 28, for training.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. I’ll set the start date as March 1 for billing, and we can enable access on February 28 for training at no charge. Training is the same two 90-minute sessions included in your package.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Do you need a new PO for the prorated amount, or can we use the existing blanket PO?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: The existing blanket PO has $9,200 remaining, so it covers the $4,736. I’ll reference PO 77341 on the order form and invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send me the order form today if you can. I can sign it by Wednesday morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the order form with the seat count, co-termed dates, separate line item, and PO reference. Once it’s signed, we’ll schedule the February 28 enablement and the two training sessions.
